changes.description: Browse offers from participating brands after verifying student eligibility. Each brand sets its own terms and verification requirements.
Browse student offers and verify eligibility with Student Beans. Savings, exclusions and verification requirements vary by brand.

changes.name: SheerID student verification
changes.description: Some brands use SheerID to confirm student eligibility. Start with the brand’s offer page and follow its verification steps; requirements vary by offer.
Discounted Creative Cloud Pro subscription for eligible students and teachers. Verify with a school email or accepted enrollment documents; introductory and renewal prices differ.

changes.name: Office 365 Education
changes.description: Eligible students and educators can access Office 365 A1, including web versions of core Office apps. Desktop app access depends on your school’s license; verify eligibility before buying.
A bundle of developer tools and partner offers for verified students. Individual offers have their own eligibility rules, usage limits and expiration dates.
Verified students and educators in eligible educational programs can create an Education team with Professional-tier access. School-managed access has separate requirements.

Eligible college and university students or teachers can get a free Education plan for a one-member workspace using an institution email. Annual verification is required; student organizations apply separately.
Participating libraries provide LinkedIn Learning at no additional cost to patrons. Check your library’s website for its login link, card and PIN requirements.

Discounted U.S. Premium Student plan currently includes Hulu with ads, subject to eligibility. Student status is verified through SheerID and renewed annually; the student offer has a four-year limit.
Discounted YouTube Premium for students at eligible higher education institutions. SheerID verification and annual re-verification are required, for up to four consecutive years.

changes.name: BYOjet for Students (formerly StudentUniverse)
changes.description: StudentUniverse now operates as BYOjet for Students. The booking service advertises fares for students, young adults and other travelers; availability and restrictions vary by itinerary.
Check your school and local transit agency for student fares or campus pass programs. Eligibility, enrollment verification and required fare cards vary; a school ID alone may not qualify.
Apple’s U.S. Education Store offers special pricing on eligible products for qualifying education customers. Check current eligibility, purchase limits and terms before ordering.
Samsung’s Education Offer Program provides eligible students and educators access to selected offers. Verification can use a school email or ID.me; product exclusions and terms apply.
Dell’s Education Purchase Program offers eligible students and teachers additional savings. A Dell account, Dell Rewards enrollment and status verification are required; exclusions apply.
Under Armour’s official student offer uses UNiDAYS verification for an extra online discount. Check current exclusions and checkout terms.
Eligible college and graduate students can receive 50% off a Walmart+ monthly or annual membership after verification. Membership renews and benefit restrictions apply.
Verified university and post-secondary students can subscribe at the student rate. Delivery benefits apply only to participating merchants and qualifying order minimums; other fees may apply.

changes.name: Chase Secure Banking
changes.description: Chase Secure Banking waives its monthly service fee for account owners ages 17–24. Account approval and other fees apply; review current terms. Chase College Checking is no longer offered to new applicants.
Paid U.S. internships and co-ops in aerospace engineering, digital technology, commercial operations, finance and other business areas. Qualifications and locations vary by posting.

changes.name: Uber Internships and Emerging Talent
changes.description: Uber’s directory for university internships and early-career programs. Search current roles for team, location, student eligibility and compensation; availability varies.
Paid foreign-affairs internships in U.S. offices and overseas posts. Applicants must be U.S. citizens age 18 or older and meet academic, security-clearance and other program requirements.

The Peace Corps Student Internship Program includes paid general and legal internships as well as unpaid placements. Enrollment, work arrangements and compensation depend on the advertised opportunity.
Paid internships for degree-seeking students and occasional recent graduates in policy research and business functions. Review each cohort’s official listings for eligibility and application dates.

Paid summer internships for undergraduate and graduate students supporting the Society’s work. The 2026 cycle was postponed; consult the official program page for the next cohort and application window.

changes.name: Mayo Clinic Administrative Internship
changes.description: A 10–12-week healthcare administration internship for graduate students. This program is for administrative leadership experience; clinical, nursing and laboratory training use separate programs.
BMW Group U.S. internships and co-ops across manufacturing, engineering and business teams. Student enrollment, academic level, location and work-authorization requirements differ by program.

Summer internships across Goldman Sachs business areas for students pursuing a college or university degree, usually in the third or penultimate year. Eligibility and available locations vary by program.

changes.name: EY Internships and Student Programs
changes.description: EY’s directory of internships and student opportunities. Choose a current program and location to review academic requirements, recruiting timelines and compensation.
Paid U.S. summer internship program for full-time undergraduate students age 18 or older at the start. Work authorization without employer sponsorship, GPA and on-site attendance requirements apply.
